Clerk binds JWT and opaque OAuth tokens to the canonical MCP resource and owns its protected-resource challenge with scopes. Cloudflare Access is supported for humans on direct Worker invocations through edge-validated application AUD and ctx.access; Node uses Clerk. Machines use stored cta_ tokens; static bearer is removed. Downstream auth and auth elicitation follow-ups remain in #707.

features.notes: PKCE, state, issuer, origin, and Clerk resource-audience binding have regressions. Disconnect attempts advertised RFC 7009 revocation after local removal; failures are typed and payload-free.
